reviews.author: Leah Johnson
reviews.text: Wilson, THANK YOU for helping me with my battery issue. I truly appreciate your act of kindness! Thanks Midnight Towing for the professionalism, understanding/willingness to work with me, punctuality, and overall customer service. 10/10 will recommend!

reviews.author: Laura Poindexter
reviews.text: Shout out to Wilson and Alex! Wilson was professional and a great guy to work with! He went out of his way to help me and my son. I will always be grateful for his help and compassion for others. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Noe Moya
reviews.text: One of the best and most reliable towing companies I've had the pleasure of working with. Despite mistakes on my end, Midnight Towing was very accommodating and extremely helpful and I could not ask for better service. Shoutout to Wilson!!!

reviews.author: Marcie Samuelson
reviews.text: My husband and I had pulled into a rest stop at midnight in Dinwiddie, VA, fell asleep for a bit with lights on and found ourselves unable to restart the car. We called AAA and they had nobody available. We called several 24/7 emergency places and nobody had a technician available. State police wouldn't assist us. We spoke to Wilson at Midnight Towing and he did not have a driver available for at least 3 hours, so he got out of bed at 1:00 am to come and help us because he was genuinely concerned that we would be stranded for several hours. While he was en route we tried again and somehow the car started. I called him back and he was almost at our location which was 19 miles away from where he started. He was very good natured about being dragged out of bed for nothing and even refused payment although he more than deserved it for going well above and beyond anything I would ever have expected. If we are ever stupid enough to fall asleep at a truck stop (in a car) with lights on, he would be the first one we call....well before AAA. Thank you so much Wilson!

reviews.author: Moon Rocc
reviews.text: Great company . Great environment. Will definitely get the job done at any means. Very professional. If you’re ever stuck , definitely give them a call . You won’t regret it

reviews.author: L. Breezy
reviews.text: Towed my truck from vsu to Newport news. Worked with me on the price. The steering wheel was locked and he parked It perfectly. Outstanding service is an understatement. God bless them!

reviews.author: Jacob Crosby
reviews.text: Decent rates, with excellent communication, punctuality, and professionalism. They hauled my 3/4 van for me with no problems.

reviews.author: Kevin Cameron
reviews.text: They got there very fast. Did a great job very professional for the price they quoted me on the phone.! What else could you ask for?

reviews.author: Danitra Nash
reviews.text: Would use company again! Phillip arrived at the dealership before I did and got my car home in a timely manner. Great costumer service!
